title: OpenMind decoder status
description: Heartbeat of the decoder, published on openmind/v1/status at least every 0.5 s (2 Hz). Real objects must stop when no status arrived for 2 s, or when state is not running.

state.description: Only running allows objects to move.

ts.description: Unix time in seconds (UTC) when the message was created.

model.description: Name of the decoding model in use (empty if none).

user.description: Current user, or null when no profile is loaded.

assistance.description: Optional. Share of help given during guided calibration (1 = fully assisted, 0 = none).

message.description: Optional human-readable detail, e.g. why the decoder is degraded.
